subject: Request to keep trial active while procurement investigates invoice
body:
From: Alice Monroe <alice@mediwell.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@mediwell.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial at risk — procurement flagged invoice, can you pause timer?

Hi Jasmine,

Quick one — our procurement team started an internal review of the vendor invoice this morning and paused the purchase approval. They say it may take a few business days to resolve. We still need to keep the proof-of-concept running for the data team to finish the integration tests.

Is there any way Redwood can keep our trial environment active (or grant a short extension) while procurement investigates? If you need a PO number or contact, loop in procurement@mediwell.com — they have the case number 2027-09-MW-45.

Appreciate any help,

— Alice Monroe
Director of Data Platforms
MediWell

----
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@mediwell.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial at risk — procurement flagged invoice, can you pause timer?

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads up and for including the procurement contact.

We can absolutely help preserve the POC while procurement finishes their review. I can apply an interim 7-day extension to the trial environment immediately so your team won’t lose access while the invoice case is open. If you need longer, we can escalate to a 21-day grace period, but that requires quick approval from my billing colleague (cc’d).

Next steps:
- Confirm you want the immediate 7-day extension today (I can apply it now).
- If procurement expects more than a week, tell me the expected hold window and we’ll route an escalation.

I’ve cc’d Camila for technical handoff and Neha for billing approval.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

----
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@mediwell.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial at risk — procurement flagged invoice, can you pause timer?

Hi Alice — following up from Jasmine. If it helps MediWell maintain momentum, I can approve a 21-day temporary sustain on the trial while the procurement review runs, provided we have the PO number or an internal ticket ID that shows the review is active (your case number 2027-09-MW-45 should suffice).

I’m happy to mark this as an exception on our side so your team can finish integration testing without interruptions. To keep approvals tidy: could procurement reply to this thread confirming the expected hold duration? If they confirm >21 days, I’ll route to RevOps for extended exceptions.

If you want me to enact the 21-day window now, say the word and I’ll instruct billing to provision it.

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@mediwell.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial at risk — procurement flagged invoice, can you pause timer?

Hi all — confirming I applied a 21-day interim credit to MediWell’s sandbox project today (reference receipt attached). This is recorded as a temporary promotional allowance tied to deal MW-TRIAL-202709 and will not invoice while the promo is active.

Attachment: interim_credit_receipt.pdf — contains credit id and expiry.

Alice — I also added a short note in HubSpot (link below) with the procurement case number for traceability. If procurement confirms the hold will be longer than 21 days, please request an extension here and include the expected duration.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890
Trial policy: https://redwood.app/docs/trial-policy

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

----
